name: io.github.rentit/mcp-quotes
title: Rent.it Airport Car Rental Quotes
description: Real-time airport car rental quotes from Rent.it.

tools.name: CreateQuoteByIATA
tools.description: Search airport car-rental rates in real time from rental companies' systems and return the complete quotation. Prices and availability can change with each request. Results can take up to 15 seconds for airports with many suppliers. Searches are subject to per-IP rate limits. The user can be redirected to the selected rate's quotation page using its BookUrl when available. Pricing and availability come directly from Rent.it car rental partners. Your booking is completed on Rent.it's own secure checkout, so card details are never entered in chat. This version does not finish bookings in chat and does not support changes to existing reservations; for those, visit rent.it or call +39 079 0976250.

pickUpIata.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for pickup.

pickUpDate.description: Local pickup date and time in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss format, without a time zone.

dropOffIata.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for drop-off.

dropOffDate.description: Local drop-off date and time in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss format, without a time zone.

remoteIp.description: Required: IP address of the end user making the search.

driverCountryCode.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code of the driver's residence.

driverAge.description: Optional driver's age at pickup, between 18 and 90 inclusive.

language.description: Optional language code: DE (German), EN (English GB), US (English US), ES (Spanish), FR (French), IT (Italian), RO (Romanian), RU (Russian).

currency.description: Optional three-letter currency code, for example EUR.
